However, the eleven industrial accounts, including yours, will need a named contact at Calder Junction. We are preparing a standard reply for any customer inquiries regarding the closure until the official notice is issued. For now, please expect a new account contact soon to assist you. If you have any further questions, feel free to reach out.
message_text: Our site is assigned to the Brannock Ridge office. Should we expect any disruption to our metering or a new account contact soon?
